description.value: Harris Green Liquor is a locally-owned, family-run neighbourhood liquor store in the heart of Victoria's Harris Green district, in business since 2005. It carries a broad selection of BC craft beers, international spirits, wine, ciders, coolers, and non-alcoholic beverages. A touring cyclist moving through Victoria's urban core could stop here to restock on drinks.
